name: Blake 5 Piece Black & Natural Extendable Dining Set

dimensions.raw: Blake Black & Natural Extendable Dining Table, SKU: 20086114008, Quantity: 1, Dimensions: 66"W x 38"D x 30"H, Finish: Black & Natural; "extend the table from 48'' to 66'' using the 18'' leaf"; Blake Black & Natural Ladder Back Dining Chair, SKU: 20086114006, Quantity: 4, Dimensions: 21"W x 18"D x 39.5"H
dimensions.source: The set page's Products included rows and Description, read in Chrome 2026-11-10. An extending table: w is the closed 48"; the 66" is open, in notes.

notes: Rejected 2026-11-10: too short and too light. Open with its 18" leaf it is 66" long, under F-60's 72" (three a side), and 48" closed; its top is natural wood on a black base (Finish Group Natural), the pale top F-68 (10) rules out on the white marble. Its 38" across would have fit (F-36: 30" a side). $499.00 on the Black Friday $799-and-under page. Cottage; MDF, hardwood and rubberwood solids; ladder-back chairs.
